caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned object resembling a hand tool, depicted in shades of brown that suggest a wooden material. The object consists of a long, tapered, and curved main handle with a rounded end, adorned with carved grooves running lengthwise. Attached at an angle near the end of the handle is a shorter manage with a bulbous center and turned details, giving it a lathe-turned appearance. Both sections are joined with a mechanical-looking hinge or connection near the top, where the handles meet. The background is a light beige with subtle textured shading, and there are visible drawn shadows and highlights on the object, indicating its three-dimensional form. The name "ED. J. GILSLEIDER" is written near the lower right of the object, along with other faint handwritten notes below it.
title: Watchman's Rattle
